name: Impute missing values when any missingness exists

conditions.description: The dataset has at least one missing value.

reason_template: The dataset contains missing values, so a preprocessing step is needed to preserve rows and avoid data loss.
limitations: Can introduce bias if missingness is not random
notes: Use as a general missing-value rule.

name: Prefer median imputation for numeric features

conditions.description: At least one numeric feature contains missing values.

recommendation: Use median imputation for numeric columns.
reason_template: Numeric columns contain missing values, and median imputation is robust to outliers.
limitations: May hide the shape of the missingness pattern
